title: Letter of Commitment Template.pdf (attachment — Purchasing with Purpose: Procurement on Sponsored Projects)
content:
Attachment: Letter of Commitment Template.pdf
Downloadable file attached to the ORA eTraining module "Purchasing with Purpose: Procurement on Sponsored Projects", lesson "MSU: Subawards vs. Subcontracts ".
Source: https://articulateusercontent.com/rise/courses/dr1x0wltGUgaTDQoS3qhL4PZTBSM_JJf/-1E0OyC4xdTujRII-Letter%2520of%2520Commitment%2520Template.pdf

Organization Letterhead
Organization Name
Organization Address
Date
Reference: PROJECT TITLE
Dear Prime/PTE Principal Investigator
This letter confirms that the appropriate program and administrative personnel at INSERT
UNIVERSITY are committed to entering a subagreement with Morgan State University for the
performance period of xx/xx/xxxx to xx/xx/xxxx. The Sub-awardee Principal Investigator for
INSERT UNIVERSITY on this proposal is NAME.
INSERT UNIVERSITY’s budget, budget justification, and scope of work are provided as
separate enclosures to this letter. The estimated cost of the proposed initial subcontract will not
exceed $xxx,xxx.xx and includes appropriate direct and indirect costs. Additional funds for
participants will require modification to the original sub-award and bilateral signatures. The
signing of this letter by an Authorized Representative is evidence of institutional concurrence
with the proposed statement of work, budget, and budget justification.
All Administrative correspondence, including any subcontract documents, should be directed to
this office. If you have any questions or concerns or need any further information, please contact
the POC for this proposal:
